author: feral-core
description: Control the QtBot/CuteBot desk robot (Elecfreaks Smart Cutebot on micro:bit V2) over USB. Use for line-following on the black-on-white track, table exploration with built-in edge and obstacle reflexes, emergency stop, manual wheel drive, and telemetry reads. Motion commands are CLOSED-LOOP: every result includes 'verified' (read back from robot telemetry). NEVER tell the user a motion command worked unless verified=true. If verified=false, call cutebot__status to diagnose, retry once if it makes sense, and otherwise report the concrete blocker (battery switch, robot lifted, USB link) honestly.

endpoints.description: Start autonomous line following on the QtBot/CuteBot desk robot. The robot follows a black line on a white track; firmware handles obstacle reflexes. Requires user confirmation before motion starts. The result is VERIFIED against robot telemetry: only claim line-following started if verified=true. If verified=false the robot did NOT start — use the error text and cutebot__status to diagnose, then report the real blocker.

Start table exploration on the QtBot/CuteBot desk robot. The robot roams an open surface with built-in edge detection and obstacle avoidance reflexes. Requires user confirmation before motion starts. The result is VERIFIED against robot telemetry: only claim exploration started if verified=true. If verified=false the robot did NOT start — use the error text and cutebot__status to diagnose, then report the real blocker.

Manually drive the QtBot/CuteBot desk robot wheels. Set left and right motor speeds from -100 to 100 (negative = reverse). Dangerous — requires confirmation; speeds above 80 are denied. Firmware auto-reverts to autonomous mode after 1.5s without drive commands, so drive is a transient pulse: the result reports post-action telemetry and a 'stopped' state afterwards is normal, not a failure.
endpoints.returns_description: {ok, command, left, right, verified, transient, telemetry}

endpoints.description: Emergency stop for the QtBot/CuteBot desk robot. Stops motors immediately and keeps them stopped. Always allowed without approval — use when the user says stop or when a behavior must be cancelled. The result is VERIFIED against telemetry; if it ever reports failure the robot may STILL BE MOVING — re-issue halt and warn the user immediately.
Read passive telemetry from the QtBot/CuteBot desk robot: online state, active mode, behavior state, sonar distance, line sensors, light level, pitch, and battery power. No approval required.
endpoints.returns_description: {online, mode, state, sonar_cm, line_left, line_right, light, pitch_mg, battery}
